Key Docker ideas:

  • An image is a read-only template; a container is a running instance of an image
  • A Dockerfile describes how to build an image layer by layer
  • Volumes persist data beyond a container's life
  • Docker Compose defines multi-container apps in a YAML file

Core Kubernetes objects:

  • Pod — smallest deployable unit, one or more containers
  • Deployment — manages ReplicaSets for rolling updates and scaling
  • Service — stable network endpoint for a set of Pods
  • ConfigMap / Secret — configuration and sensitive data
  • Ingress — HTTP routing into the cluster
